NAME: Out-of-sample integrity
CRITERION: every signal produced by a model fitted only on earlier seasons; no duplicated (game, market, side) bet

NAME: Statistical significance
CRITERION: bootstrap 95% CI lower bound on flat-stake ROI above zero AND two-sided exact binomial p <= 0.05

NAME: Economic significance
CRITERION: ROI under the strategy's own staking plan at least 2%

NAME: Beats naive baselines
CRITERION: flat-stake ROI above all three always-on baselines on the same window

NAME: Luck robustness
CRITERION: flat-stake ROI still positive after dropping one-score games (margin <= 3) and blowouts (margin >= 21)

NAME: Parameter stability
CRITERION: at least 60% of neighbouring parameter values stay positive

NAME: Non-redundancy
CRITERION: absolute correlation with any already-accepted strategy at most 0.85

NAME: Trailing performance
CRITERION: trailing 200 settled bets at flat stakes show negative ROI

NAME: Signal decay
CRITERION: trailing 100 bets have a mean signed edge at or below zero

NAME: Drawdown
CRITERION: peak-to-trough drawdown exceeds 25 units, which is 25% of the starting 100-unit bankroll

NAME: Signal score floor
CRITERION: signal_score falls below 50 on the trailing window

NAME: Confidence loss
CRITERION: two consecutive 100-bet windows with a bootstrap 95% CI lower bound at or below zero

NAME: Price integrity
CRITERION: more than 20% of signals could not be executed at the recorded price
